items.profile: {highlight}: edit your name and interface language, and view your email and role.
items.security: {highlight}: change your password and add or remove passkeys to sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or your device PIN.
items.notifications: Notification preferences by event: choose {highlight} independently. CRM and Push are enabled by default; Email is optional.
items.calendar: Updated {highlight}: lists and calendar, grid and timeline, with day, week and month views. Your selected view is remembered.
items.expenseReports: Improved apartment selection and {highlight}. Sort by name, amount, owner or property.
items.serviceTranslations: Automatically translate or manually edit {highlight} in Russian, English and Hebrew. Translations appear in bookings and the calendar.
items.navigation: Open the {highlight} by clicking your name, or the profile icon on mobile. Find profile, security, release notes and sign out in one place.
items.reload: Fixed rendering errors in profile, passkeys and notifications after a {highlight}.
items.consistentDesign: {highlight} now follow a consistent design, including on mobile.
items.guestCatalogue: {highlight} with featured apartments, a catalogue, map, photo galleries and property pages. WhatsApp enquiries include the selected apartment and stay dates.
items.publicationSettings: {highlight}: a dedicated dialog for the public title, description, page address, catalogue order and grouped amenities. Publication status appears in the apartment list.
items.bookingIntegration: {highlight}: connect, disconnect, sync manually and view import status in apartment integrations.
items.operationsDashboard: {highlight} with weekly cleanings, urgent work, staff workload and arrival preparation. You can keep using the previous dashboard layout.
items.publicationLanguages: {highlight} on the guest website. Public text supports automatic translation and manual editing; language selection is remembered and Hebrew uses right-to-left layout.
items.apartmentPhotos: {highlight} for the CRM and website: drag photos with an insertion preview; the first photo is the cover. All photos appear on the website in the same order.
items.savedApartmentFilters: {highlight} now include publication status. Search and filters are saved separately for each user and organization.
items.compactNavigation: {highlight} can collapse to icons and remembers your choice. Apartment editing sections use the available screen width.
items.dashboardPlanning: {highlight} shows total, urgent and unassigned work with links to filtered lists. Mobile sections are more compact and arrival preparation has clearer period controls.
items.catalogueSearch: {highlight}: added a sitemap, robots.txt and links to alternate language versions for search engines.
items.publicationValidation: {highlight} shows required-field errors, generates readable page addresses and handles address conflicts. Publishing requires photos; deleting the last photo hides the listing.
items.publicationPrivacy: {highlight} become inaccessible when unpublished; public caching is disabled. Archived and inactive apartments are excluded from the catalogue.
items.publicSiteSettings: {highlight}: select the address and contact profile in Website settings. Edit the photo, phone and descriptions in four languages in your profile; changes require no website rebuild.

instructions.title: Create a Telegram bot
instructions.description: Create a bot with BotFather and connect it to the CRM.
instructions.createText: Open the official {'@'}BotFather in Telegram, tap Start and send /newbot. When asked for a name, enter a guest-facing name such as Apartment Guests.
instructions.createAlt: Example BotFather chat with /newbot and the name Apartment Guests.
instructions.usernameText: Enter a unique username such as my_apartments_bot. Use 5–32 Latin letters, numbers or underscores, ending in bot. If it is taken, choose another one.
instructions.usernameAlt: Example of choosing my_apartments_bot and receiving a bot link.
instructions.tokenText: BotFather will send a token below “Use this token to access the HTTP API”. Copy the entire string, including the numbers, colon and letters.
instructions.tokenAlt: Example BotFather message with a masked access token.
instructions.connectTitle: Connect the bot to the CRM
instructions.connectText: Return to messaging settings, paste the token into Bot token and click Connect. Share the bot link with your guest. The guest must tap Start and send a message for the conversation to appear in the CRM.
instructions.exampleNote: Images show example conversations. Telegram may look different; the token is masked.
instructions.tokenPrivacy: Keep the token like a password: it grants control of your bot.
